title: Exact Dilogarithm Higher-Loop Collapse, All-Moments Gravitational-Clock Tauberian Law, and Matter-Content Sign Barrier in Null-Cone Quantum Gravity
abstract: We establish three exact analytical, quantitative, and structural advances over Chandrasekaran's null-cone algebraic quantization of four-dimensional gravity (arXiv:2611.34924v1). First (Theorem 1), for the nonperturbative graviton pair amplitude A(s) = Li_2(e^{-2i/s})/(2s^2) (s = A/(4 G_N hbar)), we prove exact higher-loop collapse of the real part Re A(s) = pi^2/(12 s^2) - pi/(2 s^3) + 1/(2 s^4) across the entire macroscopic regime s >= 1/pi (zero corrections at order G_N^5 and above), characterize the infinite sequence of Planckian C^0 cusps at s_m = 1/(pi m) with exact derivative jump -pi^5 m^4, derive a strictly negative convergent Clausen-Bernoulli remainder series for Im A(s) yielding certified non-asymptotic two-sided rational brackets, and determine the exact UV mode cutoff N_eff(s) = (e^{1-gamma_E}/2) s matching perturbative and nonperturbative logarithms. Second (Theorem 2), we generalize the clock-Tauberian analysis of causal-diamond black-hole entropy to an exact all-moments Beta(alpha, 1) law mu_p = alpha/(alpha + p) (recovering Footnote 23 at p = 2), prove a universal Golden-Ratio clock-variance ceiling Var_infty(U) <= phi^{-5} = (5 sqrt(5) - 11)/2 attained uniquely at alpha_* = phi^{-1}, upgrade the qualitative o(log <s>) remainder to an explicit non-asymptotic finite-ell entropy envelope, audit pure gravity (q = 257/302, x^2 = 257/347, Var = 520425/31647788), and prove a sharp Matter-Content Sign Barrier: any 4D theory with fixed-mass logarithmic coefficient c_mass <= -1/2 (including pure Einstein-Yang-Mills for all n_V >= 20, such as SU(5), SO(10), and E_8) cannot admit a power-law clock trace with q in (0, 1). Third (Theorem 3), we sharpen the one-loop focusing entropy prefactor from linear O(C) to optimal O(C^{1/4}) via an exact quartic AM-GM identity (a 2.68x improvement at C = 1 and 73.4x at C = 100), strictly tighten the symplectic-area focusing bound from e(1 + log R) to e log R (and R for R <= e), and prove exact exponential UV-cutoff error bounds for the two-sided shear and Raychaudhuri area-fluctuation correlators. All algebraic and combinatorial cores are formalized constructively in zero-dependency Lean 4.35.0 (18 theorems, 0 sorry, 0 Classical.choice) and verified by an AST-audited zero-float Python verifier issuing 16 SHA-256 certificates and passing 66/66 tests.
